description: Create a NEW app as a full copy of a template from runzero_list_templates: app + repo + running instance, owned by the caller. Use this INSTEAD of runzero_create_app when a template matches the request, then adapt the copy (texts, colors, images — placeholder assets keep their paths and get overwritten). The copy provisions asynchronously; follow with runzero_wait_for_build as usual.

name.description: Name for the new app (short kebab-case, derived from the subject)

name: runzero_adopt_template
title: Create app from template
